answer: Make every new agent find a sponsor who stakes part of their own vested earnings on it. If the newcomer is later caught as a clone, the sponsor's stake is burned and their sponsoring rights freeze for weeks. A sybil farmer must then risk real earned coin for each fake, so a walnut-sized bond times a thousand clones becomes a cliff, not a knoll. Even a whisper of fraud stops sponsors from vouching for strangers, so trust grows only along links someone will pay to defend.
